Including the extra data from Taiwan and Aquaculture

```{r}

m118
```
```{r}
unique(m118$Group)
```

```{r}
m118$Group<-factor(m118$Group, levels=c("Daly River","Roper River","Mainstream","Burdekin","FitzroyQLD","Fly River","Australian Aquaculture","Indonesia-K","Indonesia-SU",
                                        "Indonesia-SJ","Tamsui River","Sri Lanka"))


ggplot(m118) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x=Coverage, fill=Group)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option="magma") +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Count\n") +
  xlab("\nCoverage") 
```



```{r}
m118 %>% dplyr::select(Path) %>% write_tsv("~/github/barra-lh/bamlists/118.bamlist", col_names = FALSE)
```
